requirements: Provide GET /products and GET /products/{id} with packaged immutable data for p1 Notebook priced 12.5 and p2 Pen priced 2.0.

Expose the service over HTTP through a load balancer backed by at least two application VMs in two availability zones; route only to backends passing GET /health. Do not provision persistent application data storage.
Use Java 21, Spring Boot, Gradle and Docker, expose GET /health, and listen on port 8080.
cloudConstraints: Deploy to GCP asia-northeast3. Terraform must provision or explicitly reference every required cloud resource.
